messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: SEV2 -> P1: inference cluster us-east-1 reports 30% 5xx rate on /v1/generate. Pager routed to oncall-marc. Incident ID: INC-20250315-021

oncall-marc: ack — I'm up. joining war room: https://warroom.redwood.ai/r/INC-20250315-021

lena-ops: adding ops channel link and brief: looks like elevated 503s after a deploy at 02:08 UTC. observed increased KV cache misses. tagging sara-engineering for owner assignment

sara-engineering: I can take owner. Investigating model runtime and recent canary. Pulling logs now.

oncall-marc: confirming pager ack, will stay for handoff if needed :thumbsup:

sara-engineering: logs excerpt:
```
[02:09:12] model-runtime ERROR: kvcache miss rate spike: 0.78
[02:09:13] grpc: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = upstream reset
[02:09:14] serving: failed to allocate kv-cache shard
```

sara-engineering: hypothesis: new kernel selection changed memory layout, causing cache thrash on longer contexts. rolling back patch on a single node to validate.

lena-ops: can you run rollback on a canary replica? I'll spin a replacement node and warm cache.

sara-engineering: yes running rollback command:
```
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/inference-runtime --to-revision=203
```

sara-engineering: rolling back now, will post status in 90s.

jordan-product: drafting statuspage and customer note — recommend initial public status: 'Degraded performance in inference US-EAST, some requests returning 503s. Engineers investigating. No data exfiltration.'

emily-support: customer-facing template ok. I'll queue a high-priority support banner for affected customers (tagging customers with dedicated capacity) if impact continues past 15m.

jordan-product: statuspage draft:
"We are currently experiencing degraded inference performance in US-EAST causing increased error responses for text generation. Our engineers are investigating and working on a rollback to restore performance. We'll follow up with updates every 15 minutes."

emily-support: customer DM template:
"Hi — we're seeing increased errors affecting some inference requests in US-EAST. We're actively investigating and have engineers working on a rollback. We expect a resolution window within the next 30 minutes; we'll update you as we have more info. Apologies for the disruption."

oncall-marc: confirmed joined war room, available for comms and followups. :white_check_mark:

sara-engineering: rollback completed on canary, error rate on that pod down to baseline. rolling to remaining replicas with 30s pause.

lena-ops: observed aggregate 5xx drop from 32% -> 6% after canary rollback. Good sign.

jordan-product: posting initial status page now. Will update with resolution when rollback completes across fleet.

emily-support: notifying top 5 affected accounts per SLA. copying draft above.

sara-engineering: propagation ongoing, will update when all replicas pass healthchecks. current ETA ~7m.

oncall-marc: thanks team. I'll keep this thread for any additional handoffs.
